settings.heading: Why most internal tools fail
settings.subcopy: None of these are solved by another spreadsheet.

settings.pain: We shipped a demo. Nobody uses it in production.
settings.answer: Discovery starts with the job to be done and the metric, not a feature list. Staging you can open every week.

settings.pain: Every change needs the original freelancer.
settings.answer: Tests, docs and a handover. You own the repo. We can leave cleanly.

settings.pain: Integrations are duct tape, they break every month.
settings.answer: APIs designed, versioned and monitored by the same team that ships the UI.

settings.pain: The numbers in the meeting don't match the database.
settings.answer: Reporting and pipelines built with the product, not bolted on after launch.

settings.subcopy: Stack we ship most often: React, Next.js, Node, PostgreSQL, and well-documented APIs.
